verdict.rationale: Slack publishes a well-documented public Web API (RPC-style HTTP methods) and Events API for real-time calls, plus a CLI and MCP server for building/driving Slack programmatically, all backed by first-party docs at docs.slack.dev — this squarely satisfies the ask for AI-native/programmatic control. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent hands-on validation of API robustness beyond docs.
